units: <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 3:5">Pes. III, 5</cite> <he>ש׳ ישרף</he> dough beginning to ferment (on Passover) must be burnt, contrad. to <cite ref="O00662"><he>סִידּוּק</he></cite>.
Ib. איזהו ש׳ כקרני וכ׳ dough is called siur, when the cracks on the surface spread like the horns of locusts; (anoth. opin.) כל שהכסיפו וכ׳, v. כָּסַף.
Men. 53ᵃ (ref. to Lev. VI, 10) ואימא … אלא ש׳ may I not interpret, ‘it shall not be baked leavened’, but it may be baked as siur? Ib. ש׳ דמאן siur as defined by whom (by R. Meir or R. Judah)?; a. e.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 5:3:8">Y. Pes. V, 32ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>שחטו על סִיעוּר</he> if a person slaughtered the Passover lamb while having in his house dough just beginning to ferment.—V. <cite ref="O00518"><he>סִיאוּר</he></cite>.
